PHASE_5_VERDICT.POSITION_RESIDUAL_EXPLANATION: The ~1014 m mean residual is expected under the P14 join methodology: Fetch archived status GPS (single pos field at CloudEvent header time) was compared to S3A pinned Telemetry 1s AVG coordinates indexed by GraphQL bucket labels. SynqDrive code states bucket timestamps are not proven physical observation times and AVG coordinates need not match any single sample. Fetch and S4 pin are different planes without event-id lineage. Therefore large residuals do not prove Fetch archive is wrong, S3A is wrong, or decode is wrong — they primarily show non-equivalent comparison. Residual stability across ±60s shifts further contradicts a simple single-offset correction at 75m tolerance under this join.
